metrics.label: Glide distance covered by the Lean bound, h (L/D)max
metrics.source: h (L/D)max: the part covered by the Lean theorem glide_range_le (d <= h (L/D)/(1 - delta); delta = 0 here: still air, steady unpowered glide)

metrics.label: Level kinetic-energy phase (OUTSIDE the Lean theorem; assumption flagged)
metrics.source: OUTSIDE the Lean theorem: level flight at the launch height decelerating from the launch speed to v_min at (L/D)max with the measured ground-effect drag factor; assumes (L/D)max throughout and launch speed = airspeed; ground-effect drag factor 1.000

metrics.label: Sum: Lean-covered part + kinetic phase (the sum is NOT covered by the theorem)
metrics.source: glide_range_lean_bound_m + kinetic_phase_m; NOT covered by the Lean theorem as a whole

metrics.label: Launch speed reachable by this organism
metrics.source: what-if override launch_airspeed_override_m_s = 10 m/s (not this organism's measured speed)

metrics.label: Wing loading W/S (lifting area)
metrics.source: m g / lifting area (derived)

metrics.label: Minimum lift-supported airspeed
metrics.source: sqrt(2W/(rho S C_Lmax)), physics/results.json interpretation B

metrics.label: Launch speed minus v_min
metrics.source: launch speed - v_min

metrics.label: Descent airspeed at best L/D (C_L(0 deg) 0.53, approximate)
metrics.source: v_min sqrt(C_Lmax / C_L(0 deg)); C_L(0 deg) = 0.53 from Park & Choi lift-equals-weight at 0 deg (approximate)

metrics.label: Time airborne (bound)
metrics.source: (L/D)_eff (v0 - v_min)/g + h (L/D)/v_LD; v_LD uses C_L(0 deg) 0.53 (approximate)

metrics.label: (L/D)max used
metrics.source: Park H, Choi H (2010). Aerodynamic characteristics of flying fish in gliding flight. J Exp Biol 213:3269-3279, Table 2 (stuffed C. hiraii in a wind tunnel); borrowed: this animal's own polar is not measured

metrics.label: Power for level flight at v_min, W v_min/(L/D)max
metrics.source: physics/results.json interpretation C formula

metrics.label: Fick aerobic power bound eta E Q Ca
metrics.source: eta E Q Ca, Ca 0.1896 ml/ml at PO2 20.5 kPa (Hill P50 3.31 kPa, n 1.34), Q 0.0007 ml/s

metrics.label: Aerobic power available / power required
metrics.source: >= 1 would mean the O2 budget does not forbid level flight (necessary, not sufficient)

validity.notes: Mass 0.0006943 kg is outside 0.02-0.4 kg (polar specimens 0.04-0.06 kg; field fliers to ~0.4 kg): polar extrapolated. glide_range_total_m exceeds the Lean bound whenever the kinetic phase is non-zero; only glide_range_lean_bound_m is covered by glide_range_le. Fick bound: arterial PO2 taken equal to air PO2 and gills taken to work in air; gills do not ventilate in air (physiology chain), so for a gill-breather this is a generous upper bound. TFF: NOTES-FOR-HUB.md item 2 says only 29.5% of the flight muscle the simulator charges fits in the body. This module uses no muscle power (the Fick bound is the cap), so the issue does not enter here; any muscle-based claim for the TFF must take it into account.

whatif_glide_rerun.scope: Still air over a flat surface; steady glide polar of stuffed flying fish in a wind tunnel; ranges are upper bounds (every metre at (L/D)max). Only glide_range_lean_bound_m is covered by the Lean theorem glide_range_le. Launch speed is the organism's own sourced leap/burst speed (or a labelled what-if). Takeoff (taxiing), control, stability, flapping and burst power are not modelled. survives = null (a glide attempt is not a lethal perturbation in this model); feasible = lift can carry the weight at the reachable launch speed (null if no sourced launch speed). Out-of-validity results are reported under out_of_validity and are NOT law violations. STATE comes from the parametric body plan (anatomy-model/parametric), the project growth trajectories (development/) and physiology/ constants. Many inputs are assumed or borrowed from other species; check weakest_input on each field. MORPHOLOGICAL interpolation, not genetic hybridisation (anatomy-model/parametric/design-schema.json): a blended or edited parameter set is a shape, not an organism; it says nothing about whether such an animal could be bred, is viable, or is developmentally reachable.

validity.notes: Mass 0.0006943 kg is outside 0.02-0.4 kg (polar specimens 0.04-0.06 kg; field fliers to ~0.4 kg): polar extrapolated. Mean-chord Reynolds number ~4.6e+3 is outside 5e3-1e5 around the polar's Re ~1e4 (Park & Choi: 'gliding flying fish (Re ~10^4)'; air kinematic viscosity 1.46e-5 m2/s). glide_range_total_m exceeds the Lean bound whenever the kinetic phase is non-zero; only glide_range_lean_bound_m is covered by glide_range_le. Fick bound: arterial PO2 taken equal to air PO2 and gills taken to work in air; gills do not ventilate in air (physiology chain), so for a gill-breather this is a generous upper bound. TFF: NOTES-FOR-HUB.md item 2 says only 29.5% of the flight muscle the simulator charges fits in the body. This module uses no muscle power (the Fick bound is the cap), so the issue does not enter here; any muscle-based claim for the TFF must take it into account.

STATE comes from the parametric body plan (anatomy-model/parametric), the project growth trajectories (development/) and physiology/ constants. Many inputs are assumed or borrowed from other species; check weakest_input on each field. MORPHOLOGICAL interpolation, not genetic hybridisation (anatomy-model/parametric/design-schema.json): a blended or edited parameter set is a shape, not an organism; it says nothing about whether such an animal could be bred, is viable, or is developmentally reachable.
